title: Find a B&H photo
lede: Launch an editable B&H product search and bring a photo back into the draft without an image-search API key.

changes.now: A prefilled editable query opens B&H in a separate tab, including when the API provider is unavailable.

changes.was: Protected B&H links could fail previews; selection could precede image load.
changes.now: B&H image links use the static host, selection waits for a loaded preview, and product links get recovery guidance.

verification: 84 focused tests passed; TypeScript, scoped lint, and application build passed.
Actual shared image picker exercised in Chromium at 1280, 768 and 390px; no page errors.
Fixture checked query encoding, empty-query disablement, product-page recovery, and selected normalized image URL.

Authenticated isolated ADMIN preview at 1280 and 768px loaded a live static B&H image, staged it, and removed it; no inventory writes or page errors. Equivalent pasted B&H links retain preview readiness.
notes: No inventory mutations or deployment. B&H product-page HTML is not fetched; use the photo address or upload.
Matched captures precede the final equivalent-URL readiness fix, which does not change presentation; the authenticated check exercises the final source.
